title: Forms & Validation
summary: Use built-in validation and accessible labels.
body:
## Basics
Pair inputs with `<label>` and use proper types.

## Native validation
Leverage `required`, `pattern`, and constraint APIs.

```html
<form>
  <label for="email">Email</label>
  <input id="email" type="email" required>
  <button>Submit</button>
</form>
```

title: Meta & SEO Basics
summary: Structure head tags for better discoverability.
body:
## Head essentials
- `<title>` unique per page
- `<meta name="description">` concise summary
- Social: Open Graph and Twitter tags

```html
<head>
  <title>Page</title>
  <meta name="description" content="...">
</head>
```

title: Accessibility Landmarks
summary: Mark up pages with standard landmarks.
body:
## Landmarks
Use `<header>`, `<nav>`, `<main>`, `<footer>`, `<aside>` to aid navigation.

```html
<main role="main">
  <nav aria-label="Primary">...</nav>
</main>
```

title: Custom Properties
Flexbox Patterns
body:
## Centering
Use `display:flex; justify-content:center; align-items:center;`.

## Equal columns
Flex children with `flex:1` share width.

```css
.container { display:flex; gap:1rem; }
.container > * { flex:1; }
```

title: DOM Selection & Manipulation
summary: Query elements and update the DOM safely.
body:
## Select
`document.querySelector` for single, `querySelectorAll` for lists.

## Update
Use `textContent` and `classList` for safe updates.

```js
const el = document.querySelector('#app');
el.textContent = 'Hello';
```

title: Events & Delegation
Fetch & JSON
Modules
Useful Utilities
body:
## Debounce
Throttle frequent calls to improve performance.

```js
function debounce(fn, wait){ let t; return (...a)=>{ clearTimeout(t); t=setTimeout(()=>fn(...a), wait); } }
```
